item.name: The magic scroll
item.description: Parchment carrying a map of the crypt and the notes of the volunteers who came before you. It returns to the castle when its bearer dies.

item.name: Skein of white yarn
item.description: Pure white wool with a faint glow. It unspools by itself and marks the path you took.

item.name: Crystal vial
item.description: Full of clear water from the green chamber. Warm, and better than it looks; it is drunk once.

item.name: Bottle of viperblood
item.description: Emerald water from the river under the crypt. The colour does not fade.

item.name: Green robes
item.description: Taken from a burnt corpse beside a funeral pyre. They smell of ash, and they are warmer than what you came in wearing.

item.name: Gold ring with an emerald
item.description: Found in the burnt goo of the pudding. Warm to the touch, and it steadies the hand.
